about.title: About
about.subtitle: WHO I AM
about.bio_p1: I am Isroil Islomov, a frontend developer. I have been writing code for about two years — mostly JavaScript and React — and I care about how a page behaves on a real device, not only how it looks in a design file.
about.bio_p2: Right now I work on real products: Formo (formo.uz), a sportswear customization platform, and the Vibrant School platform for an educational centre. There, architecture, state and maintainable code matter more than getting a single screen to look right, and that has taught me more than any tutorial.
about.bio_p3: AI tools are part of my daily workflow. They take the routine work; the decisions, the review and the code that ships are mine.

ai_skills.title: AI in my workflow
ai_skills.subtitle: HOW I ACTUALLY USE IT
ai_skills.intro: AI is part of how I write code — not a separate specialisation I am claiming.
ai_skills.pair_desc: I use Claude Code and Cursor to plan changes, refactor components and find my way around unfamiliar code faster.
ai_skills.context_desc: Specific instructions and a properly described problem. The output is only as good as the context I give it.
ai_skills.review_desc: A second opinion on structure and edge cases before I commit, and a faster path through errors I have not seen before.
ai_skills.ownership_desc: AI takes the routine work. I read, test and take responsibility for everything that ends up in the repository.
